summary: Post-market view (2026-10-20 US regular-session close; the 1-year daily series carries a 2026-10-20 last bar and the quote matches that bar, so this is a settled close rather than a pre-close snapshot). Composite risk score 57.44, level caution, regime risk_on, down 1.46 from 58.9 on 2026-10-19. The 2026-10-20 history row was first written at 07:50Z with 60.73 at level high_risk and this post-close layer overwrote it in place with 57.44, so the trend_1d reading of 3.29 is an intra-day change and 1.46 is the cross-session change; trend_1w is 4.39 and trend_1m is 8.58. The session was a rotation inside technology rather than a directional move: 16 of the 22 sector and theme rows rose and 6 fell, mean 0.6936%, with autonomous_driving up 2.2694%, quantum_computing up 1.8537% and ai_software up 1.7919% leading, while the semiconductor chain fell together, semiconductor_equipment down 1.4039%, memory down 0.611%, semis down 0.4856%, data_centers down 0.4239% and semiconductors down 0.3825%. The 5 AI hardware names in the fact layer mostly closed lower: Micron 896.070007 down 0.9758%, AMD 534.73999 down 0.6152%, Nvidia 216.470001 down 0.2856% and Broadcom 334.369995 down 0.0658%, with Tesla 373.709991 up 1.5351% the sole exception; on the week all 5 are still lower, AMD down 11.6906% and Broadcom down 6.4202%. The decisive caveat is vintage: rates, credit, volatility, breakevens and SOFR all carry the 2026-10-19 FRED print, so the 10-year yield at 5.15, the 2-year at 4.77, the 10-year real rate at 2.8, high yield OAS at 3.29, investment grade OAS at 0.87 and VIX at 18.44 describe Monday being caught up rather than Tuesday's session; overnight reverse repo at 0.227 is the only macro liquidity series stamped 2026-10-20, and the FX block is still the 2026-10-16 print, 2 sessions behind rates. Dimension scores are macro 73.53, liquidity_credit 70.33, equity_structure 66.9, volatility 34.46, cross_asset 37.5 and trend 44.93; the 1.46 cross-session fall is led by volatility at 0.8715 and equity_structure at 0.512, with cross_asset unchanged. Confidence is 0.9077 (data quality 1.0, coverage 0.93, consistency 0.6787) and all 7 input datasets are fresh, so data_freshness is recorded as fresh. A-shares are the 2026-10-20 close, 9 up and 2 down of 11, with 688008.SH at 169.270004 up 2.4327% the strongest and 688825.SH at 40.32 down 2.8902% the weakest. Crypto is on a 24-hour basis and points to risk appetite: bitcoin 82509.0 up 0.69987%, ethereum 2433.98 up 1.45766% and SOL 105.87 up 1.33875%. The next checkpoint is the 2026-10-21T12:00:00Z earnings cluster of META, T and TSLA.

top_risk_drivers.claim: High yield OAS at 3.29 is the largest single contributor at 6.44 points; the reading is 0.02 tighter than the previous print of 3.31, but it shares the 2026-10-19 vintage with VIX and therefore describes Monday rather than Tuesday.
The 10-year real rate at 2.8, up from the previous print of 2.74, contributes 4.94 points; the macro dimension at 73.53 is the highest of the six.
Nominal rates moved up together: the 10-year at 5.15 (previous print 5.09) and the 2-year at 4.77 (previous print 4.74) leave the curve at 0.38, with the 10-year contributing 4.89 points.

Cross-asset confirmation at 0.375, meaning only 3 of the 8 production signals triggered, contributes 5.62 points and ranks second; the value was still 0.5 in the 07:50Z layer and is the largest single piece of the 3.29 intra-day fall, worth 1.875 points.

The equity_structure dimension at 66.9 is internally inconsistent: semis_relative weakened to -12.9239 from -11.6164, while breadth at 0.4, new highs at 0.0385 and new lows at 0.0705 show more names making lows than highs.

supporting_signals.claim: Volatility is the lowest of the six dimensions at 34.46, with VIX at 18.44 and realized vol at 9.0422; realized volatility is roughly half the VIX, so priced tail risk is limited.
The trend dimension at 44.93 still shows an intact price structure: price_vs_ma200 at 5.9862, momentum_3m at 2.9315 and drawdown_52w at only -1.254, none of which supports a trend break.
Credit does not confirm stress: investment grade OAS at 0.87 and high yield OAS at 3.29 are both far below stress territory, and the Fed balance sheet holds at 6755639.0.
Crypto is broadly stronger and points to risk appetite: bitcoin 82509.0 up 0.69987%, ethereum 2433.98 up 1.45766% and SOL 105.87 up 1.33875%.

Internal structure improved versus the prior session: breadth rose to 0.4 from 0.3935, new highs rose to 0.0385 from 0.0128, new lows fell to 0.0705 from 0.1026, and small_cap_relative improved to -9.0481 from -10.9505.

contradicting_signals.claim: The fall in the composite is not new information from today: rates, credit, volatility, breakevens and SOFR all carry the 2026-10-19 print, so VIX falling from 19.99 to 18.44 and high yield OAS narrowing from 3.31 to 3.29 are Monday's readings being caught up and cannot be read as Tuesday de-risking.

The index-level tape was not weak: 16 of the 22 rows rose with mean 0.6936%, with auto up 1.5351%, fintech up 1.6235% and gaming up 1.662%, so breadth supports risk appetite rather than risk aversion.

6 of the 22 rows are ETF proxies (cloud_computing, cybersecurity, enterprise_software, semiconductors, internet_platforms, gaming); their change_1d is the move of a single ETF rather than an equal-weight basket aggregate and is not comparable with the other 16 rows.

Baskets with Asian constituents have a narrower cross-section than their constituent list implies: memory excludes 5 A-share constituents by design, and consumer_electronics drops 1810.HK from the last step for lack of a 2026-10-19 Hong Kong bar, leaving only 9 members in the calculation.
The crypto readings of 0.69987, 1.45766 and 1.33875 are on a 24-hour basis and do not share a window with the 2026-10-20 US session, so they cannot confirm the intraday move of the day.

Confidence is internally inconsistent: the headline 0.9077 is composed of data quality 1.0, coverage 0.93 and consistency 0.6787, and consistency is notably low; the 36.03-point gap between macro at 73.53 and cross_asset at 37.5 is the quantified form of that disagreement.

The FX block is still the 2026-10-16 print, two sessions behind rates, so the broad dollar at 121.4048 is not a current reading; the Fed assets and reserves block is 2026-10-14, which is the normal weekly cadence.

bull_case.title: Bull case: the rotation broadens and the vintage catch-up keeps pulling the composite down
points: Volatility at 34.46 is the lowest of the six dimensions; if the 2026-10-20 VIX print also lands near 18.44, the composite holds below 57.44 and probes 55.

16 of the 22 rows rose with mean 0.6936%; if ai_software at 1.7919%, cloud_computing at 1.403% and enterprise_software at 0.8869% keep leading while the semiconductor chain stops falling, the advance broadens.
Credit does not confirm stress: high yield OAS 3.29, investment grade OAS 0.87 and the Fed balance sheet at 6755639.0.
The 2026-10-21T12:00:00Z META, T and TSLA earnings are the near catalyst; the trend dimension at 44.93 and price_vs_ma200 at 5.9862 show the trend still has support.

base_case.title: Base case: the composite oscillates inside caution while the macro leg stays restrictive
points: The composite oscillates between 55 and 60: macro at 73.53 and liquidity_credit at 70.33 offset volatility at 34.46 and cross_asset at 37.5, leaving the six dimensions close to neutral in aggregate.

The mixed-vintage state persists: equities are the 2026-10-20 close while the macro leg is the 2026-10-19 print, so a material part of any day-to-day move remains catch-up rather than new information.
The semiconductor chain stays the weak leg (semis -0.4856%, memory -0.611%, semiconductor_equipment -1.4039%) while the AI software side stays the strong leg, a rotation rather than a one-way move.
The combination of a real rate at 2.8 and a 10-year at 5.15 leaves limited valuation cushion, so any hot inflation or labor print is amplified straight through the macro dimension.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the semiconductor leg drags breadth and the macro leg re-tightens
points: Semis relative at -12.9239 and small cap relative at -9.0481 are both negative; if breadth at 0.4 turns down, equity_structure at 66.9 rises back toward 70, worth roughly 0.6 points on its own.
Cross-asset confirmation returning to 0.5 pushes the cross_asset dimension back to 50, adding 1.875 points; that is the symmetric reverse of the 3.29 intra-day fall.
If credit follows the macro leg: high yield OAS at 3.29 needs to widen only 0.1 to 3.39 for liquidity_credit at 70.33 to rise with it, and that dimension carries a weight of 20.0.
If VIX returns above 19.99 with the 2026-10-20 print, the volatility dimension rebounds from 34.46 and the 1.46 cross-session fall is erased.
